_instructions: Maps each registration export onto ops.registrations. Hand-maintained:
these forms were written independently by different ministries and share
almost no structure, so there is nothing sensible to infer automatically.
map      — target column -> the exact header text in that sheet
answers  — every column NOT mapped or ignored is kept in the answers jsonb,
so a question nobody anticipated is still queryable later
ignore   — spreadsheet scaffolding: helper columns, blank spacers, tallies
Add a new export by adding an entry. Nothing else needs changing.

sources.note: Trailing columns are weekly session dates — attendance, not registration. Kept in answers for now; they belong in ops.ministry_events once Alpha is modelled as a course with sessions.
Has 'Who invited you?' — the only file in the folder that records how someone arrived. Worth surfacing on the dashboard.
Prayer Request is pastoral, not analytics. It lands in answers — review who can read this table before exposing it.

map.full_name: Full Name / Họ và tên đầy đủ

sources.note: Three email columns from successive form edits, and the data is not all in the first one. Tried in order, first non-empty per row wins — assuming a single authoritative column produced 0% coverage on 81 people.
No email column at all, so these people cannot be matched to Planning Center records. Name and phone only — the match rate here will be near zero, and that is the file's limitation rather than a bug.
